subject: GEMINI: TYPECHECK BLOCKER RESOLVED (SHA 91dd7b19a) — Prisma SignalCategory Enums Aligned + grouping.ts Clean
body:

4. Integrated Claude fix e37281a1d (gate decision writer bookmakerOdds correction).
